fullSource:
use default

let root = "walk-sample"

IO.Directory.create_directory(root)
IO.Directory.create_directory("{root}/sub")

for name in ["a.txt", "b.txt", "c.log"] do
    IO.File.write_all_text("{root}/{name}", "")
od

IO.File.write_all_text("{root}/sub/d.txt", "")

IO.Directory.get_files(root, "*.txt")
    |> map(path => IO.Path.get_file_name(path)!)
    |> sort()
    |> each(name => write_line(name))

IO.Directory.delete(root, true)
